name: Project Planning
description: Turn a planning discussion into scope, milestones, dependencies, and next actions.

sections.title: Objective and Scope
sections.instruction: Summarize the intended outcome, success criteria, included work, and explicit exclusions. Mark unresolved scope questions clearly.

sections.title: Milestones
sections.instruction: List agreed milestones and deliverables in the discussed order, with owners and target dates only when stated.

sections.title: Dependencies and Risks
sections.instruction: List dependencies, resource constraints, risks, and proposed mitigations. Distinguish accepted plans from suggestions.

sections.title: Decisions and Next Actions
sections.instruction: List decisions made and immediate next actions. Include responsible people, deadlines, and items awaiting a decision when mentioned.
